sentences.en: My regular waitress wouldn't have anything to do with me.
sentences.zh: 我的常客服务员根本不想理我。

sentences.en: Eleven o'clock is my regular time for going to bed.
sentences.zh: 十一点是我固定的睡觉时间。

sentences.en: It's best to go to the dentist at regular intervals.

senses.zh: 常客；正式队员；中坚分子
